title: Northwind Flow · leaving the price war in parcel delivery
subtitle: Blue Ocean Strategy · Kim and Mauborgne

eliminate: A separate fuel surcharge on every invoice
Paper customs forms filled in by the shipper
reduce: Coverage: UK and Benelux only, no pan-European promise
Account management for shippers under 2,000 parcels a month
raise: Delivery window: from a whole day to 30 minutes
Live tracking shown to the buyer, not just the shipper
Customs handled end to end on UK to EU parcels
create: A measured carbon receipt for every parcel
The buyer picks a 30-minute slot from the tracking page
Carbon data export for CSRD reporting
